name: The Corrupt Reeve
description: Reeve Aldric skims grain taxes. Peasants whisper, nobles look away.

name: A Marriage of State
description: A rival house offers a daughter with a dowry and a claim. Love or leverage?

name: The Tax Reform
description: Your chancellor proposes a new tithe. Nobles grumble, peasants hope.

name: Feud in the Council
description: Two councillors brawl over grain rights. Pick a side or silence both.

name: The Border Claim
description: A neighbor claims your eastern hamlets by an old charter. Answer firmly.

name: Petitioners at Court
description: A line of commoners waits at your gates with grievances and gifts.

name: The Vassal's Tribute
description: A hill lord arrives with iron and excuses. His tribute is light again.

name: Law of Succession
description: Clerks urge you to codify who inherits. Every house watches your quill.

name: Defend Greenhollow
description: Raiders probe the border village. The militia begs for aid before next moon.

name: The Elite Guard
description: A veteran offers to forge peasants into an elite guard — for a price in coin and horses.

name: First Campaign
description: Your new guard thirsts for trial. A bandit nest festers in the hills.

name: Night Raid Repelled
description: Torches on the border. Raiders strike granaries under moonlight.

name: The Mercenary Offer
description: A sellsword company offers blades for coin. Their loyalty lasts while gold does.

name: Raise the Walls
description: Masons beg stone for the crumbling east wall before winter sieges.

name: Deserters in the Woods
description: Hungry levies melt into the woods. The captain demands examples or bread.

name: War Horses
description: A steppe trader offers prime destriers. Cavalry dreams gallop in your marshals.

name: The Salt Road
description: Merchants propose a salt road through your lands. Tolls or free passage?

name: Famine Recovery
description: Last season's hunger lingers. Granaries need refilling before winter returns.

name: Grain Speculators
description: Merchants hoard grain to spike prices. Intervene or let the market bite?

name: Silent Hammers
description: Smithies idle for lack of iron. Tools break, plows wait, soldiers drill with sticks.

name: The Weavers' Guild
description: Weavers seek a charter and looms. Cloth could clothe the realm — and fill coffers.

name: River Tolls
description: Barges crowd your river. A toll chain could pay for itself by autumn.

name: Winter Stores
description: Snow comes early to the high passes. Cellars must be full or bellies empty.

name: Debased Coin
description: The mint master whispers: lighter coins, fuller treasury. None will notice — at first.

name: A Great Work
description: Artisans dream of a monument that will outlast crowns. Will you fund it?

name: The Heresy
description: A preacher declares the old gods dead. Crowds gather, some with stones.

name: College of Bards
description: Wandering singers seek patronage for a school of song and story.

name: Harvest Festival
description: Barns bulge and the people ache for music, ale, and a bonfire.

name: Shrine of the Old Gods
description: Moss covers stones where grandparents prayed. Restore them or let them sleep?

name: The Scriptorium
description: Monks offer to copy every scroll in the realm — if you feed and house them.

name: Tournament of Banners
description: Knights polish armor and egos. A tourney would thrill the realm.

name: Procession of Saints
description: Fever stalks the low town. Priests propose a procession to lift hearts.

name: The Rival's General
description: A whisper: the enemy general camps poorly guarded. A knife could end a war before it starts.

name: Steal the Codex
description: A rival keeps a codex of irrigation secrets. Your scholars covet it.

name: The Poisoned Cup
description: Your taster collapses at supper. Someone in your own hall wants you dead.

name: The Turned Courier
description: A captured courier offers to feed lies to your enemy — for gold and mercy.

name: Smugglers in the Marsh
description: Boats without lanterns move cloth and iron through the marsh. Tax them or join them?

name: Forged Letters
description: Your seal-master can imitate any hand. Whose orders shall you rewrite?

name: Eyes on the Towers
description: Signal fires blink where no orders were given. Spies use your own towers.

name: Whispers of Revolt
description: In taverns they toast a nameless 'true king'. Find him before the toast becomes a march.

name: Heir's Tutelage
description: Your heir comes of age. How will you shape their heart?

name: The Ruler's Ambition
description: Late at night you stare at maps. Will you be builder, conqueror, or sage?

name: An Old Friend
description: A muddy rider from your youth begs audience — and, likely, a favor.

name: The Boar's Charge
description: A boar gores your huntsman saving you. The court holds its breath.

name: The Queen's Fever
description: Your spouse burns with fever. Physickers argue leeches versus herbs.

name: A Bastard's Claim
description: A youth with your eyes demands recognition at the gates. The court snickers.

name: A Pilgrim's Vow
description: In a dream the saints call you to walk barefoot to the white shrine.

name: The Oath Renewed
description: Years on the throne dull vows. The clergy offers a renewal before the realm.
